name: separate-upper-forms-variable-base
heightMeaning: Early photograph rod-tip height above assumed ground; no late-form height is inferred
assumptions: Roof at ~50 shaku is the metric-scale scenario, not a survey point.
North faces share a symmetric variable base; roof lines and turret faces are coplanar.
Turret lantern tops use variable square-turret width; vertical outer edges are infinite lines.
Near/far intrados crowns have equal height only in includeFarCrown scenario.
View-A early upper form is independent of the plate46 later photographed form; plate46 upper landmarks are excluded.
Rod is centred over a shaft at chosen setback; gallery/crown segments vary within chosen bounds.
All bounds, principal-point ranges and initial values are working scenarios, not historical measurements.
South camera is calibrated on base only; shared dimensions are frozen and upper points withheld.
Working tracing weights and Huber loss do not define measurement confidence intervals.
